value: new debt financing plus existing ABL capacity
calculation_or_source: Company expected to use new debt financing and existing capacity under its ABL facility
what_it_says: URI publicly identified new debt financing and ABL capacity as the expected funding channels.
what_it_does_not_say: It did not quantify the exact split at announcement.

value: 1.100B USD 6 1/8% senior notes plus ABL drawings
calculation_or_source: FY2024 acquisition footnote funding language
what_it_says: The filed acquisition footnote says senior notes and ABL drawings funded the acquisition and related fees.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not disclose the exact ABL dollar amount or purchase-level source-and-use schedule.
next_source: Debt note and ABL draw detail

calculation_or_source: Base purchase price disclosed by URI
what_it_says: The base purchase price was 1.100B USD.
what_it_does_not_say: It is not the same as acquisition-date fair value or invested capital.

calculation_or_source: Acquisition-date fair value from purchase accounting
what_it_says: The acquisition-date fair value of purchase price was 1.158B USD.
what_it_does_not_say: It is not mat fleet OEC or replacement cost.

calculation_or_source: Principal amount of 6 1/8% senior notes used to fund acquisition and related fees
what_it_says: URI issued 1.100B USD of senior notes as a core funding source for Yak.
what_it_does_not_say: This does not show note maturity, underwriters, or all covenant terms.

calculation_or_source: 6 1/8% senior notes
what_it_says: The acquisition funding notes carried a 6.125% coupon.
what_it_does_not_say: The row does not yet provide maturity or yield/spread detail.

calculation_or_source: Filing says drawings on ABL facility funded acquisition and related fees but does not quantify amount
what_it_says: ABL drawings were part of the funding chain.
what_it_does_not_say: Exact ABL dollars, timing, collateral, and repayment/refinancing path are not disclosed in the current source set.
next_source: ABL availability schedule and cash-flow financing detail

source_file: derived from rows URIYAFC-004 and URIYAFC-006
calculation_or_source: 1.100B USD senior notes / 1.100B USD base purchase price
what_it_says: The senior-note principal equaled the announced base purchase price.
what_it_does_not_say: This does not mean notes alone funded every related fee or the exact closing cash flow.

source_file: derived from rows URIYAFC-005 and URIYAFC-006
calculation_or_source: 1.100B USD senior notes / 1.158B USD acquisition-date fair value
what_it_says: Senior-note principal covered about 95.0% of acquisition-date purchase-price fair value.
what_it_does_not_say: This does not identify the exact residual funding source or transaction-fee funding split.

metric: Acquisition fair value less senior notes
source_file: derived from rows URIYAFC-005 and URIYAFC-006
calculation_or_source: 1.158B USD acquisition-date fair value - 1.100B USD senior notes
what_it_says: Acquisition-date fair value exceeded senior-note principal by about 58M USD.
what_it_does_not_say: This is not necessarily the exact ABL draw because acquisition and related fees, contingent consideration, cash timing, and definitions differ.

calculation_or_source: Estimated contingent consideration included in fair value
what_it_says: Estimated contingent consideration was 41M USD within the purchase-price fair value.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not disclose if or when contingent consideration was paid.

calculation_or_source: Purchase accounting rental equipment acquired
what_it_says: URI allocated 127M USD of fair value to acquired rental equipment.
what_it_does_not_say: It is not OEC, replacement cost, or all operating invested capital.

metric: Senior notes / acquired rental-equipment fair value
source_file: derived from rows URIYAFC-006 and URIYAFC-013
calculation_or_source: 1.100B USD senior notes / 127M USD acquired rental-equipment fair value
what_it_says: Senior-note principal was 8.66x the acquired rental-equipment fair value because the acquisition value included customer relationships and goodwill.
what_it_does_not_say: This does not mean debt was economically supported only by rental equipment.

calculation_or_source: Filed Q1 2024 ABL facility balance

what_it_does_not_say: It does not show how much of the balance was drawn specifically for Yak.
